subject: Order SO-2026-0231 delay + firmware issue — refund expected

messages.body: Kelly, this is the second time SO-2026-0231 has been pushed back. Our line is idle and procurement is asking for a written explanation. We also still see the vision module misalignment after the 4.2 firmware update (ticket SUP-7781). Frankly we are evaluating alternative vendors. We expect a partial refund or credit and a clear recovery plan by end of week.
Wei-Ming, thank you for the direct feedback. I'm pulling logistics and engineering into the same room today and will come back with a recovery plan. I hear the urgency.

Kelly, four days, no plan. Our CTO is now in the loop and is asking about the renewal in August. Please confirm by tomorrow: (1) revised delivery date, (2) refund or credit amount, (3) firmware fix ETA. Otherwise we will pause the renewal discussion.
